text:
lee_csm: Heads up — ClearWave account showing a steady daily API call drop over the last 10 days (~40% M/M). Drop started ~day 14 post-onboarding. Renewal window in ~6 weeks. Any quick, low-friction interventions we can run?

aisha_cs: Seen. They mentioned in last check-in they moved a bunch of work to an internal queue to cut costs. Risk level: medium->high given renewal. My gut: micro-intervention rather than full outreach.

josh_se: Quick data point: I noticed p95 generation latency spikes around 2024-11-05 10:12 UTC for that tenant. Likely KV cache got disabled after a config change. Snippet from infra logs:```
[2024-11-05T10:12:03Z] clearwave-prod - p95_gen_latency=1.12s model=redwood-xxl-8q batch=auto
```
If the cache is off, token cost & latency both go up -> users throttle.

olivia_onboarding: I can jump in for a 20–30 min re-orientation with their tech lead (Tara). Offer to RSVP a short walkthrough of the quickstart, batching tips, and how to enable burst capacity. Can do next Tue/Wed.

lee_csm: Proposal: micro-intervention checklist (quick, measurable, owner-assigned)
1) 15–30m enablement call (owner: olivia_onboarding)
2) Temporary credit to offset spikes while we stabilize (owner: lee_csm + billing-bot approval)
3) Infra fix: verify KV cache + batching policy (owner: josh_se)
4) Set a short success metric and monitor (owner: aisha_cs) — target: return to >80% of baseline DAU within 10 days.
5) Capture friction points (docs/quickstart) and file a docs ticket if needed (owner: aisha_cs).

aisha_cs: Assigning tasks now. Olivia -> schedule call and share agenda. Josh -> infra check + rollback plan. Lee -> draft credit request and renewal flag. I'll compile notes and own post-mortem if it trends poorly. :thumbsup:

josh_se: Infra check status: confirmed KV cache was off on clearwave-prod. Re-enabling now. Command used:```
rwctl cluster update --cluster clearwave-prod --enable-kv-cache true
```
Also adjusted batching policy to default for short sequences. Monitoring p95 after change.

olivia_onboarding: Scheduled 2024-11-10 14:00 PT with Tara (CTO) — invite sent. Agenda: 1) 10m overview of token economics and batching 2) 10m hands-on walkthrough (enable KV cache) 3) 5–10m Q&A + next steps. Added quick doc link in invite: https://redwood.ai/onboard/quickstart-bridge

lee_csm: Drafted credit ask to billing: temporary credit 1,000 token-equivalent to offset potential cost while they ramp back up. Also drafting a non-disruptive downgrade/safe-path note (if they insist on cost cuts): provide a starter model mapping + automatic fallback policy so their app doesn't error.

billing-bot: Credit request B-412 created for ClearWave: 1000 token-equivalent pending approval.

aisha_cs: Captured feedback point from Tara: webhook/event docs confusing; they're dropping a lot of async events into their own queue bc they thought retries were costly. I'll open a docs ticket and link to the call notes.

lee_csm: OK — run this micro-intervention for two weeks. Report cadence: quick status update in #customer-health every Mon (2–3 lines). If DAU doesn't recover to >80% baseline in 10 days, escalate to a renewal health check with AE. Tagging @billing-bot for approval flow.

josh_se: Post-change p95 looks better in the last 30m: 0.28s -> 0.34s range. I'll keep an eye on tail.

olivia_onboarding: Post-call follow-up note ready to send to Tara with replay + config checklist. Will include links and a 1-click rollback snippet for them.

lee_csm: Thanks team. Small ask — capture the call outcome and any customer friction as bullets in the convo. We'll use that for the retrospective and the docs ticket.

aisha_cs: Will do. Adding a quick tracker row in the CS board: status=active, intervention=start=1705000000, owners=[olivia_onboarding,josh_se,lee_csm], metric=DAU >= 80% baseline.

lee_csm: :raised_hands: Good move. Back here in 10 days with results or earlier if anything changes.
